module.purpose: Provides a lightweight generic memoization cache that associates computed values with object keys while allowing keys to remain garbage-collectable.
module.summary: This module defines a reusable cache abstraction backed by WeakMap. It lazily computes a value on the first request for an object key, stores that value, and returns the same cached value on later requests. The implementation supports generic key and value types, restricts keys to objects, and does not expose explicit eviction because WeakMap lifecycle follows key reachability.
module.businessContext: Supports efficient reuse of computed object-derived data across application utilities. Failure causes repeated computation or propagated callback errors, while retained keys do not prevent garbage collection.
classes: WeakCache (~L24-64): Generic weakly referenced storage for lazily computed object-keyed values
functions: get (~L57-63): Retrieves a cached value or computes and stores it
systemCapabilities: Allow garbage collection of unused keys

units.name: WeakCache
units.source:
export class WeakCache { /** * The internal WeakMap storage for cached key-value pairs. * * @public */ items = new WeakMap() /** * Get the cached value for a given key, computing it if not already cached. * * Retrieves the cached value associated with the given key. If no cached * value exists, calls the provided callback function to compute the value, stores it * in the cache, and returns it. Subsequent calls with the same key will return the * cached value without recomputation. * * @param item - The object key to retrieve the cached value for * @param cb - Callback function that computes the value when not already cached * @returns The cached value if it exists, otherwise the newly computed value from the callback * * @example * ```ts * const cache = new WeakCache() * const element = document.getElementById('my-element')! * * // First call computes and caches the bounding rect * const rect1 = cache.get(element, (el) => el.getBoundingClientRect()) * * // Second call returns cached value * const rect2 = cache.get(element, (el) => el.getBoundingClientRect()) * // rect1 and rect2 are the same object * ``` */ get

(item: P, cb: (item: P) => V) { if (!this.items.has(item)) { this.items.set(item, cb(item)) } return this.items.get(item)! } }

(item: P, cb: (item: P) => V)
preconditions: item is a valid key for the underlying weak cache.
cb is callable and accepts item as its argument.
postconditions: Returns the value associated with item.
If item was not cached, stores the callback result for item before returning it.
If item was already cached, leaves its cached value unchanged.
invariants: The callback is invoked at most once for each cache miss handled by this call.
Cache presence is determined independently of the cached value, so a cached undefined-like value is not recomputed when the key is present.
edgeCases: For an already-cached item, returns the existing value and does not invoke cb.
For an uncached item, invokes cb(item), stores its result, and returns that result.
If cb throws, the error propagates and no callback result is stored.
stateMutations: Mutates this.items by storing the callback result for an uncached item.
detail.summary: Returns the cached value associated with an item, computing and storing it with the callback when no cached value exists. Existing cached values are returned without invoking the callback.

specTests.when: Call get(item, cb) with a callback that would produce a different value.
specTests.then: The previously cached value is returned and cb is not invoked.
cb is invoked with item, its result is returned, and a subsequent get for item returns that same result without invoking the callback again.
